title: Isolation precautions

findings.where: Images 1, 6 and 7 — airborne-scene particles; isolation.jsx AIR_DOTS
findings.title: Small airborne particles have marginal contrast
findings.problem: The 2.2-unit-diameter particles use labInk at 75% opacity over the teal gradient. Light-theme contrast is approximately 2.8–3.0:1, below the project's stated contrast target. These already tiny marks become difficult to distinguish at phone width.
findings.fix: Use a higher-contrast existing ink token at full opacity. Verify contrast against the gradient at each particle location, while keeping airborne particles visibly smaller than the droplet symbols.

assessment: No substantiated clinical errors. One minor light-theme accessibility defect remains.
